tagline: SPEC-First Plan→Run→Sync with TDD gates for Claude Code.
keyFeatures: Go CLI wrapping Claude Code in a SPEC-First Plan→Run→Sync lifecycle
TDD gates with an 85%+ coverage target enforced per SPEC
Per-SPEC git worktree isolation for parallel development (/moai plan --worktree)
Agent catalog separates planning from auditing so authors don't grade their own work
Tokenomics model/effort routing to control token spend
moai web serves a six-tab settings console
limitations: Claude-Code-only — no other harness or agent runtime supported
Benchmark and coverage claims are self-reported, not independently verified
Full SPEC lifecycle is heavy ceremony for small changes
